name: Vincent
source: The rich and popular student who is used to getting whatever he wants. Somehow, he has only just realized no one really likes him and are only friends with him out of fear or greed. Since the main character was the only one nice enough to cheer him up after his resulting breakdown, he's become rather fixated on keeping the protagonist by his side forever.
